screen.brewbloom.title: BrewBloom
screen.brewbloom.subtitle: Cosmetic potion bloom editor
screen.brewbloom.import_help: Paste colors, import them, create a gradient, or copy this palette.
screen.brewbloom.profile_help: Paste a profile to import. Empty text changes nothing.
screen.brewbloom.desc.mode_effect: Uses the original Minecraft color of each active status effect.
screen.brewbloom.desc.mode_rgb: Automatically cycles through strong neon colors over time.
screen.brewbloom.desc.mode_rainbow: Automatically cycles through a smoother full-color rainbow.
screen.brewbloom.desc.mode_custom: Uses the three manual colors configured below.
screen.brewbloom.desc.radius: Controls how far bubbles orbit from the player.
screen.brewbloom.desc.density: Controls how many bubbles spawn for each active effect.
screen.brewbloom.desc.effect_limit: Limits how many active effects can spawn bubbles at once.
screen.brewbloom.desc.total_bubbles: Caps the total number of bubbles spawned per cycle.
screen.brewbloom.desc.style: Cycles between every available bubble movement style.
screen.brewbloom.desc.height: Controls how much of the player height can emit bubbles.
screen.brewbloom.desc.rise: Controls how fast bubbles float upward.
screen.brewbloom.desc.swirl: Controls how fast bubbles orbit around the player.
screen.brewbloom.desc.color_speed: Controls how quickly animated color modes change.
screen.brewbloom.desc.crowd_start: Starts reducing bubbles per effect after this many active effects.
screen.brewbloom.desc.custom_colors: These three colors are used by Manual mode and gradients.
screen.brewbloom.desc.rgb_controls: Adjust red, green, or blue for the selected color slot.
screen.brewbloom.desc.picker: Pick saturation, brightness, and hue for the selected color.
